primaryTextRead.text: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

negativeWikipediaSearch.resultsSummaryJa: Obadiahの専用記事は預言者を扱い、人物一覧のObadiah節はArnanの子でDavidの子孫という1CH3:21の別人を指す。9:16のシェマヤ—ガラル—エドトン系譜を対象とする専用/共有項目は確認できない。

contextReviewed.text: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
contextReviewed.decision: 別人として除外。オバデヤはアルナンの子らの系譜に置かれる。

contextReviewed.text: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
contextReviewed.decision: 同名の別人物。イツラヒヤの子らの一人。

contextReviewed.text: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
